title: Concise Trump Assassination Coverage
superchats: Taking a shot, even under the best circumstances, isn't easy. Doing so while under stress (which the SSCS would be), is very difficult to pull off. ANYONE who's done Inf. Training can confirm this.
It's a modern day "Bull Moose" moment basically.
